fields.label: API token
fields.description: Lenco API v2 bearer token. Also keys the webhook signature (HMAC-SHA512 with the token's SHA-256 hex digest).

fields.label: Maximum per transaction (ZMW)
fields.description: Mobile money ceiling. Larger amounts must be paid by bank transfer.

fields.label: Fee bearer
fields.description: Sent explicitly: Lenco has been seen defaulting to customer, which charges the buyer more than the total.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.description: Register this URL in the Lenco dashboard.
